title: Double glass shelf 16-Inch Wall Mount with Gallery Rail Solid Brass Hardware Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom or home storage with a 16-inch double glass shelf that keeps essentials organized while freeing up counter space. This wall-mounted glass shelf features two tiers of 3/8-inch thick tempered glass and a gallery rail designed to help keep items in place. Built with solid brass hardware and concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look—ideal for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Double shelf design maximizes space for toiletries and accessories
- Tempered glass shelves (3/8-inch thick) for strength
- Gallery rail helps prevent items from sliding off
- Solid brass hardware for lasting performance
- Concealed screw installation for a streamlined wall shelf appearance

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Overall dimensions: 16 in (L) x 8 in (H) x 5 in projection
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount (includes installation hardware)
- Included items: glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: false
- Coordinates with the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place accessories; distinctive finish options available in 28 designer finishes (including Glokzin Teal, Venetian Bronze, Lavender, Mediterranean Blue, Sea Foam Green)
